assessment: Configured tools may perform operations; no dedicated Sele site-management UI.

feature: Publish Site updates and manage access
assessment: Requires the hosting service and connected tool permissions; no native publishing controls.

feature: Create or edit Space Pages through connected tools
assessment: A configured Space plugin can expose APIs; Sele has no native Pages workspace.

feature: Use the collaborative Space block editor
assessment: No native block editor, sharing UI, page comments, or collaborative presence.

feature: Set up and supervise an ongoing dot assistant
assessment: No dot identity, messaging channel setup, supervision, or persistent task UI.

feature: Use the Codex Security plugin
assessment: Connected security tools may execute; permissions and rich workbench flows remain conditional.

feature: Review findings in the Security workbench
assessment: No native findings inbox, triage UI, or security workbench.

feature: Co-edit text or code in Canvas
assessment: Sele edits local files and accepts comments; no hosted Canvas version/suggestion workflow.

feature: Choose a custom GPT in a conversation
assessment: Sele skills/plugins are distinct from the ChatGPT custom-GPT runtime.

feature: Read context from a supported external IDE or notes app
assessment: Sele reads project files; it does not implement Classic Work with Apps context capture.

feature: Edit code inside an external IDE from Classic
assessment: Sele’s built-in editor is separate from external-app patch application.

feature: Use Apple Handoff for a conversation
assessment: No Apple Handoff integration.

feature: Use menu-bar or dock integration and login launch
assessment: No corresponding Classic-style menu-bar/launch-at-login settings were found.

feature: Answer provider requests for the current time
assessment: The exported currentTime/read server callback has no handler and is rejected as unsupported.

feature: Handle legacy command and patch approval callbacks
assessment: Modern item approval callbacks are handled; legacy execCommandApproval and applyPatchApproval are not.

feature: Render every current protocol item kind
assessment: The installed protocol has 19 item variants; several rely on generic or absent handling. An unknown item type is not evidence of complete transcript parity.

feature: Copy messages and code blocks
assessment: Message and code-block copy controls are implemented; whole-transcript export is separate.

feature: Move several chats between projects at once
assessment: No multi-select conversation transfer action or provider project-move integration.

feature: Customize dictation cleanup and specialist vocabulary
assessment: No dictation recorder, cleanup pipeline, or custom vocabulary settings.

feature: Choose a light or dark app icon
assessment: No in-app Dock/icon customization control.

feature: Search across every settings panel
assessment: Resource and feature filtering exist; no unified all-settings search.

feature: Choose bottom or side placement for terminal tabs
assessment: Sele has a terminal panel and workspace scoping; no equivalent bottom-versus-right placement preference.

feature: Reorder queued follow-up messages with drag and drop
assessment: Editing/deletion and queued delivery exist; no drag ordering for pending messages.

feature: Warn when the requested model is downgraded
assessment: Model discovery and per-message labels exist; no dedicated downgrade warning flow.

feature: Review multiple outstanding approvals
assessment: Sele can store pending requests and approve per chat, but shows one current request rather than a complete parallel approval interface.

feature: Adjust zoom independently for each window
assessment: UI/code font controls exist; no explicit per-window zoom setting.

feature: Choose the application interface language
assessment: No localization catalog or interface-language selector was found.

feature: Navigate back and forward through app screens
assessment: Browser history controls exist; no comparable global screen-history navigation controls were found.

feature: Keep and reorder multiple source-file tabs
assessment: Recent files and editor dialogs exist; native thread-side-panel tab-strip and drag-order parity are not established.

feature: Keep the app in a system tray with usage controls
assessment: No native tray lifecycle or account-usage tray menu was found.

feature: Inspect subagent-specific diff statistics
assessment: Subagent transcripts and status exist; no dedicated per-subagent changed-file statistics surface was established.

feature: Review generated files through rich artifact cards
assessment: File references and media are shown; office/PDF citation cards and native review are not fully implemented.

feature: Keep pins synchronized with other first-party devices
assessment: Sele pins are local metadata, not the shared desktop/mobile account pin state.
